name: Option 12
definition: Provides the details for a call/put option.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Identifies whether the instrument has a call option or a put option. If the instrument contains both options, i.e. a call and a put, both the call option and the put option have to be reported.

DateOrPeriod.name: Date Or Period
DateOrPeriod.definition: Provides the exercise date or notice period for a call/put option.
